Bug_Title: IL: A collection is added to itself (IL_CONTAINER_ADDED_TO_ITSELF)
Bug_Details:
A collection is added to itself. As a result, computing the hashCode of this
set will throw a StackOverflowException.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug() method when we add the buggySet to itself. This will cause a StackOverflowError when we try to compute the hashCode of this set.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the hashCode() method is called on the buggySet. This is because buggySet is added to itself in the showBug() method, causing a StackOverflowError when the hashCode() method is called.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results confirm the presence of the bug. The test code successfully triggers the bug by adding the buggySet to itself, which causes a StackOverflowError when trying to compute the hashCode of the set.
